quotes.text: A story is not a line to be followed, but a garden to be wandered—every reader finds their own path to the heart of the roses.
quotes.author: Eleanor Vance

quotes.text: Write with the courage of your contradictions, for it is in the friction between light and shadow that a character truly comes to life.
quotes.author: Julian Thorne

quotes.text: The blank page is not an abyss, but a silent orchestra waiting for the conductor's first gesture—your pen is the baton.
quotes.author: Maya al-Sahir

quotes.text: To tell a story is to build a bridge made of whispers, strong enough to carry the weight of another soul across the river of time.
quotes.author: Arthur Finch
